the DIFN method is the best method for retrieving the soil line parameters, especially at the local scale, and that the SL-related vegetation indices can be used to accurately estimate the dry biomass of agricultural crops.

the proposed DIFN method is more suitable and reliable to retrieve the SL at the local scale, and the quantile regression method using floating tau with the minimum p-value is also suitable for the same purpose at the field scale, but it is not suitable for the local scale.
